headline: Google DeepMind, Google's AI research lab, is pushing to apply its AI to agriculture, according to a video report from the Indian broadcaster NDTV.
score_reason: Lowered from 4: only the NDTV headline could be checked, so what DeepMind is doing for agriculture and what is new are unknown.
importance_line: People who grow or research crops are the ones any such AI tools would touch, then DeepMind and Google behind them, but nothing beyond NDTV's headline is confirmed: what the tools do, where they are used and what is new.
summary: NDTV, the Indian news broadcaster, reports in a video headlined 'Science At Digital Speed' on Google DeepMind's push to apply its AI to agriculture.
notes: NDTV video page blocked (HTTP 403) and no text was obtained; the related NDTV, NDTV Profit and NewsBytes pages of 11 to 12 Oct 2026 are blocked too and no other outlet carries this video. Listed by Google News on 11 Oct 2026 16:30 UTC; the event date is not known. Google News lists other NDTV interviews with DeepMind's Lila Ibrahim the same day (headlines seen, not read), so this video may be part of that series, unconfirmed.
